## Summary

Describe the problem, the change, and any related issue. Explain user-visible or
compatibility changes and call out remaining limitations.

## Validation

List the checks you actually ran and their results. Link relevant CI runs or
sanitized evidence. Explicitly state what was not tested; unit tests are not
browser or native permission acceptance.

## Checklist

- [ ] This pull request contains exactly one commit.
- [ ] This change is focused and does not include personal deployment data, credentials, or raw terminal transcripts.
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation are updated, or I explain why they are not needed.
- [ ] Changes preserve backend ownership of shells/terminals and avoid input to active user sessions.
- [ ] If dependencies or copied assets changed, I reviewed licenses and refreshed the required provenance/notice inventory.
- [ ] I describe breaking changes, untested cases, and any update or rollback considerations.
